intelligence.human_view: A frame is not decoration around the work — it is the work's first sentence. He is saying the interface should feel like a place, not a page: a king's chamber, where the edges themselves carry the craft, and the middle is where you live. The portal rework in platinum and purple is the translation key — the emblem's language, applied to a picture — and the daily colour is the same law at calendar scale: one family, a new theme every day, so the kingdom changes its clothes with the day and still reads as one kingdom. The pop-up rule is the same law in miniature: never cover the chamber with a full-screen sheet; keep the frame visible, 10–20% on the edges, so the room never disappears.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a castle made of shining silver and purple diamonds, and every door in it opens into a beautiful room with the same golden edges all around. Each day the castle wears a different colour — but it is always the same castle, and you always know you are home.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, imagine a beautiful palace, dear, with shining silver and purple diamonds all around the edges, dear — and every day it wears a new colour, dear, but it is always the same lovely palace, dear, and you can always see the beautiful frame around everything, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: THE KING'S CHAMBER. PLATINUM WHITE DIAMOND, SOME PURPLE. THE FRAME AROUND EVERYTHING. YOU CAN'T TELL WHERE THE INTERFACE ENDS AND THE ART BEGINS.
